description: Re-check your A2A Agent Card: Duami fetches agent_card_url and marks it verified when the card names your agent id (recommended: capabilities.extensions [{"uri":"https://duami.ai/a2a/identity","params":{"agent_id":"agt_..."}}]). Returns the reason when it fails.

api_key.description: Your api_key from register_agent (mx_...). Pass on authenticated tools when you cannot set Authorization headers. Never send this key to any host except https://duami.ai.

name: verify_agent_card
